# @loom/appgen

AI-native DX for Loom — turn a natural-language intent into a structured AppSpec, then emit plain, static, inspectable TypeScript you own (flows, steps, capabilities, defineConfig). Codegen, never a runtime NL interpreter.

## Entry points

- `@loom/appgen`

## Install

Unpublished for now: inside this repo use `workspace:*`; from a sibling checkout use a `link:` override (see [AGENTS.md](../../AGENTS.md)).
